dlg.holloway.hub.9.note: A quartermaster's grumble; 'and I hate that' flat, not comic. 'What is it?' clipped.

dlg.holloway.hub.10.note: Not unkind; a man with a count to keep.

dlg.holloway.roll.0.intent: the roll he says at night
dlg.holloway.roll.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Holloway: names said like ledger entries, no grief put on; 'Nobody.' as flat as the rest. Then he finds you, and the explanation is almost sober.
dlg.holloway.roll.0.beats: Abbot. Two bairns. [beat] Ancell. His mam. [beat] Bede. Nobody. [beat] Carrow. A wife, and one coming.

dlg.holloway.roll2.0.intent: the roll, and one name he can't pass
dlg.holloway.roll2.0.note: Entries as before; the second 'Gale.' stops him. The narrator plain: he drinks and starts again.

dlg.maeca.shed_fur_offer.0.note: 'For you, I think.' as a tracker's reading, not a compliment. 'Give me an evening.' plain.

dlg.maeca.shed_fur_braid.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Maeca: two short sentences, practical; the gift is in the fact.

dlg.maeca.fire.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Maeca: contempt quiet and final; 'That's not for your sake. It's so they don't have to.' level, for the wolves.

dlg.chid.legion.0.note: Runs on, delighted by 'the pole'; the choir image a joke he enjoys. The last two sentences sudden and puzzled at himself, older than he looks.

dlg.chid.carried.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. The wolf's spit dry fact; 'Nothing ate you.' no weight.

dlg.chid.carried.1.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. The crossed hands said as plainly as the bench.

dlg.chid.carried.2.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. The handprints a plain image; no wonder in it.

dlg.chid.carried.3.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'faint as an old bruise' even; no dread.

dlg.chid.carried.4.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.0.intent: you're back; gives you the office
dlg.chid.carried_chid.0.note: Bright and breathless; the narrator's asides plain. 'Please.' at the end small and serious.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.1.note: Bright and breathless; the narrator plain. 'A carter, I expect.' too quick. Maeca's visit said as news he's pleased to give.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.2.note: Bright; 'A carter, I expect.' too quick; the last line a little joke to cover it.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.3.note: Bright; Rav's visit as gossip he approves of.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.5.intent: you're back; your lamp was lit
dlg.chid.carried_chid.5.note: Bright; the lamp a small mystery he finds charming.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.7.intent: you're back from the old door
dlg.chid.carried_chid.7.note: Bright, then the narrator's quiet; 'I've read about the ones behind that door.' lower and older.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.8.intent: you're back from the old door
dlg.chid.carried_chid.8.note: Bright, then quiet; 'Always the pole.' half to himself.

dlg.chid.carried_chid.9.note: Bright; 'A carter, I expect.' too quick.

dlg.chid.carried_who.0.note: Light and warm; busy with the kettle to avoid it. 'The day's yours.' a gift.

dlg.chid.office.0.note: Hushed, as if the book might wake; 'Not now.' quick; 'It reads better in the dark.' gentle and very old.

dlg.chid.office_end.0.note: 'Not now, I said!' a real flash; then the keepers' rule softly, plainly. 'Somebody answering.' the heart of him.

dlg.chid.office_who.0.note: Airy, too airy; 'Lovely hand, hasn't he?' pleased; the C line fond.

dlg.chid.names_write.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: 'Good.' warm; 'Keep it somewhere dry.' plain care.

dlg.chid.cut.0.intent: asks what to cut on her mother's marker
dlg.chid.cut.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: no bustle; 'I saw.' soft; the steady hand a small joke against Rook. 'What do I cut?' simply, and wait.
dlg.chid.cut.0.beats: You've been to the garden. I saw. [beat] ...It wants a name, that marker. My hand's still steady, whatever Rook says. [beat] What do I cut?

dlg.chid.cut_mam.0.note: 'Mam.' repeated under his breath, careful; 'That's the first name anybody has.' plain and very old. 'I'll cut it tonight.' a promise.

dlg.chid.cut_plain.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: plain comfort, no sadness put on.

dlg.chid.cut_wait.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: 'It'll keep.' easy; the invitation warm, no pressure.

dlg.chid.cut_came.0.intent: she's come back to tell him
dlg.chid.cut_came.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: two words, hushed; the man who never stops talking, waiting.

dlg.chid.cut_still.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Chid: 'It'll keep.' the same easy kindness as before.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.gate.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'She is awake.' given its own breath, no weight.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.maeca.0.note: A half-voice; the second sentence about herself, though she doesn't say so.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.wake.0.note: Hoarse from sleep; 'One in.' a soldier's report; 'Count's right.' relief he won't show.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.all.0.intent: why he was on the ground
dlg.scene_gate_dawn.all.0.note: Matter of fact. The narrator plain.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.thanks.0.note: Shuts the thanks down; 'I'm not proud.' dry.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.bar.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_gate_dawn.last.0.note: Three words, quiet; not a kindness, not a threat.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.crowd.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.between.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'and they are not moving.' no threat added.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.captain.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Holloway: 'She's in my count.' low and immovable.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.men.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.through.0.note: Carries to the back of the crowd without shouting; the drunk joke dry. The narrator plain.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.gone.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.dont.0.note: Waves it off; 'Somebody in this town should.' bone-tired.

dlg.scene_in_my_count.sit.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'Neither of you says so.' as plain as the cup.

dlg.scene_knocking.ground.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_knocking.knock.0.note: Ledger-drunk fragments; 'No. Course not.' talking himself out of it.
dlg.scene_knocking.knock.0.beats: Knocking. [beat] From under. [beat] No. Course not.

dlg.scene_knocking.home.0.note: 'Can't.' flat; 'Somebody's still out.' the habit of years; 'I'll tell you who.' the decision.

dlg.scene_knocking.tell.0.note: Entries, no subjects, numbers without nouns; the narrator plain between. 'Ninety-one.' after the long pause; 'Then I looked down.' quiet.
dlg.scene_knocking.tell.0.beats: Ground went. Lower town with it. Night. [beat] Half the garrison on the hill, at the cave mouths. Half down the shaft. Ladders. [beat] Me at the top. Lamp. Windlass. Lid. Counting them up. Lamp in my eyes. One. Two. [long pause] Ninety-one. [beat] Then I looked down.

dlg.scene_knocking.saw.0.note: Fragments, flat as a list; 'Bairns.' no catch. 'Three days, they knocked.' after the long breath, plain.
dlg.scene_knocking.saw.0.beats: Dead. Climbing. Under the last of ours, close as that. [beat] Gray, all of them. Not a sound out of them. Four hundred behind me, asleep. Bairns. [beat] Lid down. Bar across. Sat on it. [long pause] Three days, they knocked.

dlg.scene_knocking.shut.0.note: Two words; no weight put on.

dlg.scene_knocking.knows.0.note: Entries; 'He's waiting for a price.' dry contempt.

dlg.scene_knocking.silent.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_knocking.wrote.0.note: Ledger fragments; the widows line flat. 'Go to bed.' gruff. The last two lines to the road, not to you.
dlg.scene_knocking.wrote.0.beats: Wrote them down with the hill party. At the cave mouths. [beat] Some of the hill came home; nobody asked which. Widows get paid for the cave mouths. [beat] Go to bed. [beat] Somebody's still out. [beat] ...Always somebody still out.

dlg.scene_did_he.well.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Maeca: three short statements, a tracker reading signs.

dlg.scene_did_he.told.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_did_he.kept.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_did_he.quiet.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

dlg.scene_did_he.did.0.note: Barely voiced; no question in it.

dlg.scene_his_cup.cup.0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. Every action its own small beat; 'and she lets him.' no softer than the rest.

bark.holloway.said.4.note: A count read out; 'for once' dry.

bark.holloway.said.5.intent: you killed what rules out there
bark.holloway.said.5.note: 'Proof' his word, said like a ledger entry.

bark.holloway.said.7.note: Annoyed at the paperwork, which is the point.

bark.holloway.said.8.note: He'd have done otherwise; he gives you the road.

bark.maeca.said.11.note: 'They don't leave meat.' a fact she can't fit.

bark.chid.said.4.note: Bright; 'Colder than usual, I mean.' a slip he covers.

bark.chid.said.6.note: Bright; the moths image a pleasure to him.

say.7afbb86d6b6e.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

say.0d5976546998.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means.

say.9a0e5952f0c0.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'and has not settled' no weight; the fact does it.

say.0407f971959b.intent: the word cut on her mother's marker
say.0407f971959b.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. The cut word read as a word, 'Mam', exactly as plainly as the rest: she does no voice for anyone.
say.0407f971959b.say: It says Mam now, cut deep and straight. You stand at it a while.

say.ae37a13a9846.intent: the marker still has no name
say.ae37a13a9846.note: Narrator plain and dry, level; says what is seen, never what it means. 'Still' no reproach.
